title: Green Dog Library
description: A top-down view of an octagonal library room with blue brick walls and a white marble floor. A large glowing green dog stands in the center while a human hand holds a glowing vial in the foreground. Shelves filled with bottles line the walls, open books with green dog illustrations float in the corners, and a wooden table displays multiple green dog poses with a 'TREATS' sign.
prompt: Top-down view of a circular fantasy library with dark blue brick walls and white marble floor. A large luminous lime-green dog stands in the center. Wooden shelves filled with potions and bottles line the octagonal walls. Several open books with green dog illustrations float in the corners. A wooden table in the foreground displays multiple green dog poses under a TREATS sign. A hand holds a glowing potion vial. Bones and paw prints scattered around, cartoon illustration style.
